record: Source provenance and licence evidence for the RigTale reference cast
purpose: This file is the fixture's licence evidence. It is tracked in Git so that every redistributable artifact under fixtures/ can be shown to have verified provenance and a compatible licence from the repository alone. Checksums are verified by fixtures/tools/build_cast.py on every build; a source that does not match refuses to build.
verified: 2026-08-03, SHA-256 and byte size recomputed from the retrieved archives

licence_evidence.verbatim: The archive ships no licence file. Its ten members are the Color, Displacement, NormalDX, NormalGL and Roughness JPG maps, a preview PNG, and usdc, blend, mtlx and tres material definitions. The CC0 dedication is stated on the source page, and that page is the evidence.

sources.redistribution: Unrestricted. Public domain dedication, no downstream obligation.
sources.attribution: Not required by the licence. 'ambientCG' is credited by choice.

derives.parts: every textured part: all bodies, arms, legs, clothing, hands, hair, pigtails, mochi body, head, ears and legs, cart body, wheels and handle, props ball and drum, and all four scene tiles
derives.from: Fabric034_1K-JPG_Color.jpg, converted to luminance, tiled, mean-centred and added at 0.16 strength (0.10 on scene tiles). Alpha is never touched.

generated_from_neither_source: pim, bo, nu — arm_{left,right}, leg_{left,right}: generated capsules
nu/body: generated cloud silhouette, three lobes over a rounded slab
pim, bo, nu — clothing: generated band with an original stripe, check or dot pattern
pim, bo, nu — eye_* (three gaze targets per side) and the twelve mouth states: generated
pim, bo, nu — hair, pigtail_{left,right}: generated tufts, curls and spheres
all shadow layers: generated soft blur
mochi: body, head, ears, legs, tail, eyes, nose and mouths are all generated
cart: body, wheels and handle are generated
props: ball and drum are generated
excluded: No asset, shape, colour, hair, costume or name is taken from any video reference channel. Channels studied for art direction supplied no asset.
No Adobe sample puppet and no Spine runtime example asset reaches this fixture. Their redistribution rights are not established, so they are read-only references and are not sources here.
